title: Complete conditional European text-reader address ownership
changes: Account for all physical word addresses conditionally selected by both original byte-indexed text-reader registry loads under E170.
validation: Protected static audit thuu27et checks all 256 word addresses: 98 use the new conditional source and all 158 earlier owners remain unchanged; no unowned, mixed or multiply owned words remain. No guest execution occurred.
limitations: Conditional physical ownership does not establish ordinary index values, callback invocation or the complete domains of other dispatchers. Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending; no performance measurements.
